movie.title: Walt Disney's Bedknobs and Broomsticks
movie.short_description: During the Second World War, evacuated siblings stay with apprentice witch Eglantine Price. When they discover her unfinished spell, they join her and Professor Emelius Browne on a magical journey to find the spell's missing ingredient and help defend Britain.

movie.title: The Wizard of Oz
movie.short_description: A cyclone carries Dorothy from Kansas to the magical land of Oz. Hoping the Wizard can send her home, she follows the yellow brick road with the Scarecrow, Tin Man and Cowardly Lion, while the Wicked Witch pursues them.

movie.title: Mary Poppins
movie.short_description: Magical nanny Mary Poppins arrives to care for Jane and Michael Banks. With chimney sweep Bert, she takes the children on fantastical outings, helping their strict father reconnect with his family and bringing change to the Banks household.

movie.title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
movie.short_description: On holiday in Morocco, Dr. Ben McKenna and his wife Jo learn of an assassination plot just before their young son is kidnapped. The couple follow the clues to London and race to find him before the planned attack.

movie.title: The Silence of the Lambs
movie.short_description: FBI trainee Clarice Starling seeks help from imprisoned psychiatrist Hannibal Lecter to understand the methods of serial killer Buffalo Bill. Their unsettling interviews become central to the investigation as Starling works to find the killer's next intended victim.

movie.title: The Conjuring
movie.short_description: In 1971, the Perron family move into a Rhode Island farmhouse where they encounter increasingly frightening paranormal events. Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren examine the haunting and try to help the family escape its influence.

movie.title: Bad Teacher
movie.short_description: Unmotivated teacher Elizabeth Halsey plans to leave her job and marry a wealthy man, but her plans collapse. She returns to school, where her schemes for money and a new romance collide with a rival teacher and her students.

movie.title: Rear Window
movie.short_description: Photographer L.B. Jeffries is confined to his apartment with a broken leg and passes the time watching his neighbours. When he suspects one of them has murdered his wife, Jeffries asks his girlfriend Lisa and nurse Stella to help investigate.

movie.title: Schindler's List
movie.short_description: During the Holocaust, German industrialist Oskar Schindler uses his factories and personal influence to employ Jewish workers in occupied Poland. As persecution intensifies, he risks his fortune to protect them from deportation and death.

movie.title: The Sixth Sense
movie.short_description: Child psychologist Malcolm Crowe begins treating Cole Sear, a boy who says he can see and speak with the dead. As Crowe tries to understand Cole's experiences, their work changes both of their lives.

movie.title: The Sound of Music
movie.short_description: Novice Maria becomes governess to the seven children of widowed Austrian naval officer Captain von Trapp. Music helps the family grow closer, but when the Nazis take control of Austria, they must decide how to escape.

movie.title: This Is 40
movie.short_description: Married couple Pete and Debbie approach their fortieth birthdays while juggling work, money worries, ageing parents and the needs of their two daughters. Their efforts to keep family life on track put new pressure on their relationship.
